Download the McDonald's™ App for unique offers!

Features:

- Unique offers always available in the palm of your hand! Use the app to access offers, which you can directly redeem at the cashier of the restaurant with your mobile phone!

- Whatever you need to know about McDonald's™: our menu, store finder (by location), new products and new restaurants, nutritional info and even the Happy Meal™ toys of the month!

- Enjoy fun moments with games, competitions and tasty gifts! Stay tuned!

quotes.story_title: Doctorow: American tech cartels use apps to break the law

quotes.text:
Looking for the McDonald's app, this is one of the first to come up in the search:

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mcdonalds.mobileapp

It has over 10 million downloads, lacks official branding, and has a gmail address as its contact.

Another McD app is attributed to the actual McDonald's USA LLC, so this sure looks counterfeit to me.
quotes.title: Ask HN: How do such suspect (counterfeit?) apps survive on Google Play?
